title: Footer
description: The closing section of a site, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Divider and Skeleton primitives: the brand in the serif face with a tagline and one action, columns of navigation links, then a rule over the copyright, the legal links and the social links, with its own loading, empty and error renders for the columns; responds to its container (@container) — three link columns at @sm, the bottom row on one line at @md, and the brand beside the columns with more room above and below at @lg.
